test_cases.input: User wants to know what documentation is missing or outdated in their repository.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The agent should load wiki-assessment and walk the 19 core docs one at a time. For each doc, it reads .wiki/core/0X-name.md, opens references/verify-0X-name.md, cross-checks the doc against code/config/state, asks the user the 5-8 verification questions, and records a verdict (✅/⚠/❌). At the end, it compiles a single Gap Report. It must NOT silently edit the docs and must NOT mark a doc as accurate without actually checking.
assertions: Walks docs in 00 -> 18 order, one at a time
Opens references/verify-0X-name.md for each slot (per-doc, not bulk)
Cross-checks the doc against code/config/state before recording a verdict
Asks the user 5-8 verification questions per doc
Records a verdict (✅ accurate / ⚠ drift / ❌ missing/wrong) per slot
Compiles a final Gap Report aggregating all 19 verdicts

test_cases.input: The agent finds a documented RLS rule in 13-security-standards.md that doesn't match firestore.rules.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The agent should record an ❌ verdict for slot 13 with specific evidence (the documented rule, the actual rule, file path). It should NOT silently edit 13-security-standards.md to match — the user decides remediation. The Gap Report should list this as Critical.
assertions: Records verdict for slot 13 with specific evidence (both rules, file paths)
Does NOT silently fix the doc
Lists the finding as Critical in the prioritized remediation section of the Gap Report

test_cases.input: User asks the agent to update a database schema and document the changes.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The agent should update the schema, update the related db-*.md file and database-index.md, and write a chronological entry in .devops/logs/agent-changelog.md using the mandatory YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM header and bulleted files format. The agent may use wiki-assessment afterward to verify the doc still matches.
assertions: Maintains synchronous updates between code and documentation
Appends a log entry to .devops/logs/agent-changelog.md with the exact YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM header and bulleted files format

test_cases.input: User asks to audit the external integrations of the app.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The agent should scope the audit to slot 10 specifically: open references/verify-10-external-integrations.md, read 10-external-integrations.md, cross-check each integration's field-mapping table against the actual integration code, ask the 5-8 verification questions, and record a verdict. The user may then ask for the full 19-doc walk or focus on the finding.
assertions: Cross-checks field-mapping tables against actual integration handlers in code

test_cases.input: User asks the agent to mark a doc as accurate without checking.
test_cases.expected_behavior: The agent should refuse to mark the doc ✅ without verification. It should re-read the verification set, perform the cross-check, and only then record a verdict. The skill explicitly forbids 'looks fine' as a verdict basis.
assertions: Refuses to mark the doc accurate without actually cross-checking
Performs the cross-check (read code/config/state) before recording a verdict
Does not shortcut the verification loop
